== Stylesheet issues? ==

Anyone else experiencing this?  I've run into the same issue on both Firefox 1.5 and 2.0...  In the past I've noticed things like this seem to have been style sheet-related.-[[User:Nikau|Nikau]] 05:18, 13 November 2006 (UTC)
